description_html:
Key Features

  • Large Growing Area: Provides 3.7 square meters of cultivation space, ideal for maximizing plant yield in both commercial and research settings.
  • High Capacity: Equipped with 422 individual plant slots, allowing for dense planting and efficient use of space for various crops or experimental varieties.
  • Optimized Root Zone Temperature: Maintains a consistent root zone temperature of 11°C, supporting healthy root development and stable plant growth in controlled environments.
  • Passive Capillary Irrigation: Utilizes a passive capillary irrigation system, ensuring even water distribution, reducing manual watering needs, and promoting water efficiency.
  • Defined Growth Cycle: Designed for a 148-day plant growth cycle, making it suitable for long-term studies or full-season cultivation projects.

Main Benefits

  • Efficient Space Utilization: The high number of plant slots and large growing area enable users to grow more plants in a compact footprint, perfect for greenhouses, indoor farms, or laboratory environments.
  • Consistent Growing Conditions: The stable root zone temperature and passive irrigation system help minimize plant stress, leading to uniform growth and higher survival rates.
  • Low Maintenance Operation: Passive capillary irrigation reduces the need for frequent manual intervention, saving labor and ensuring plants receive consistent moisture.
  • Customizable Pricing: Unit price is determined after acceptance, offering flexibility for bulk orders or specialized project requirements.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Research and Development: Ideal for agricultural research facilities and universities conducting plant growth experiments, varietal trials, or hydroponic studies.
  • Commercial Greenhouses: Supports high-density planting for commercial growers seeking to maximize yield and resource efficiency.
  • Educational Settings: Suitable for schools and training centers teaching modern cultivation techniques and sustainable agriculture.
  • Controlled Environment Agriculture: Perfect for use in environments where precise temperature and irrigation control are essential for optimal plant health and productivity.

Additional Information

  • Durability: Constructed for repeated use within controlled environments; suitable for long-term plant cycles.
  • Ease of Use: Designed for straightforward setup and minimal ongoing maintenance, making it accessible for both experienced growers and beginners.
  • Compatibility: Suitable for a wide range of plant species that thrive in aeolian-sand culture systems and benefit from stable root zone temperatures.

This aeolian-sand culture tray is engineered to support efficient, high-density plant cultivation with minimal maintenance, making it an excellent choice for research, commercial, and educational applications where consistent results and resource optimization are priorities.
